Aufgaben:
An der Medizinischen Fakultät der Universität Zürich ist per 1. Februar 2028 der Lehrstuhl für Neurologie neu zu besetzen. Der Lehrstuhl ist an der Klinik für Neurologie des Universitätsspitals Zürich angesiedelt und vertritt das Fach in Forschung, Versorgung und Lehre. Er ist mit der Leitung der Klinik verbunden.

Anforderungen:
Gesucht wird eine dynamische, integrative Persönlichkeit mit umfangreicher klinischer Expertise, wissenschaftlicher Exzellenz und entsprechender internationaler Visibilität. Eine Habilitation oder gleichwertige wissenschaftliche Qualifikation sowie ein Facharzttitel in Neurologie werden vorausgesetzt. Sie verfügen über ein überzeugendes Konzept für die neurologische Forschung und Lehre der Zukunft. Mögliche Forschungsschwerpunkte der Professur umfassen zum Beispiel zerebrovaskuläre Erkrankungen, die Neuroonkologie, Bewegungsstörungen, degenerative Erkrankungen und die Neuroimmunologie. Da Sie die Leitung der Klinik für Neurologie übernehmen werden, bringen Sie Leitungserfahrung mindestens auf Stufe leitender Arzt/leitende Ärztin oder leitender Oberarzt/leitende Oberärztin an einer universitären Klinik mit. Darüber hinaus verfügen Sie über umfassende Erfahrungen in der Leitung einer grösseren Forschungsgruppe, der Einwerbung von kompetitiven Drittmitteln sowie in der studentischen Lehre, der Betreuung von Qualifikationsarbeiten und der akademischen Nachwuchsförderung.

Von der erfolgreichen Kandidatin oder dem erfolgreichen Kandidaten wird erwartet, die bestehenden sowie neue Kooperationen innerhalb des Spitals und mit anderen Forschungseinrichtungen zu stärken. Insbesondere wird eine Vernetzung und Weiterentwicklung des bestehenden Klinischen Neurozentrums mit den Kliniken für Neurochirurgie und Neuroradiologie erwartet.

Die Universität Zürich bietet aussergewöhnliche Bedingungen für Spitzenforschung in der Medizin. Mit ihren vier universitären Spitälern eröffnet sie Zugang zu umfassenden Patientenpopulationen, interdisziplinären Forschungsnetzwerken und klinischer Expertise über alle Altersgruppen und Fachbereiche hinweg. Aufgrund der räumlichen Nähe zur ETH Zürich bestehen zusätzliche Möglichkeiten zu Kooperationen in Computational Medicine, Bioengineering, Data Science und KI-gestützter Medizin. Damit bietet der Standort Zürich ein translational ausgerichtetes Ökosystem, das von der Grundlagenforschung bis zur klinischen Anwendung reicht. Das Zentrum für Neurowissenschaften (ZNZ) bietet hervorragende Möglichkeiten zur Vernetzung mit grundlagenorientierten neurowissenschaftlichen Gruppen an der Universität Zürich und der ETH Zürich.

Deutschkenntnisse auf Niveau B2 des gemeinsamen europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen sollten vorhanden sein oder müssen innert nützlicher Frist erworben werden.

Die Universität Zürich ist bestrebt, den Anteil von Frauen in Führungspositionen zu erhöhen. Daher werden qualifizierte Forscherinnen ausdrücklich aufgefordert, sich zu bewerben.

Die Universität Zürich versteht Forschende als moderne Führungspersönlichkeiten, die exzellente Forschung – unter der Berücksichtigung der Open Science-Grundsätze – durch eigene Forschungsprojekte wie auch die Förderung von exzellenten Nachwuchsforschenden betreiben und die mit innovativer forschungsbasierter Lehre eine zukunftsorientierte Universität mitgestalten.

jobs.title: Head of Mass Spectrometry

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
• You will lead the day-to-day operations of the MS platform, including scheduling, quality control and sample throughput across metabolomics, isotope tracing and other MS-omics workflows.

• In this role, you drive method development for LC-MS/MS-based stable isotope tracing, metabolomics, RNA modifications and lipid analysis, including applications to in vivo and patient-derived samples.

• You ensure high data quality, robust data management and fully reproducible workflows through rigorous QC and precise documentation.

• You will co-develop and implement automated sample preparation workflows to increase throughput and improve reproducibility.

• Co-design of the data acquisition and processing infrastructure around Orbitrap Astral instruments will be part of your responsibilities.

• You maintain mass spectrometry instruments at the highest performance standards and manage service contracts as well as consumables.

• Contribution to the development of single-cell mass spectrometry methods is expected as part of the lab's technology development agenda.

• You actively contribute to research projects, from experimental planning and data interpretation through to manuscript writing.

• Training and mentoring of graduate students, postdocs, and collaborators in MS techniques and experimental design is an important part of your work.

• You advise on and support the procurement of future equipment and contribute to grant applications for infrastructure funding.

• You represent the platform in internal and external collaborations across the Zurich life sciences community.

Anforderungen:
• Expert (MSc or PhD) in analytical chemistry, biochemistry, or a closely related field - with a strong mass spectrometry track record; Experience matters

• Hands-on expertise with high-resolution LC-MS platforms, ideally including Orbitrap-based instruments

jobs.title: Professorship of Neurology

titleByLocale.fr: Professeur de neurologie

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich offers a wide range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and 12 professional apprenticeship streams, Switzerland's largest university provides an inspiring working environment at the vanguard of research and education. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
We seek a dynamic and inclusive leader with outstanding clinical expertise, a distinguished scientific track record, and strong international recognition, who can articulate a compelling vision for the future of neurological research and education. Applicants must hold a habilitation (or equivalent qualification) and board certification in neurology. Relevant research areas may include, but are not limited to, cerebrovascular diseases, neurooncology, movement disorders, neurodegenerative diseases, and neuroimmunology. Candidates should demonstrate leadership experience at the level of senior physician or senior attending physician at a university hospital. A proven ability to lead large research teams, secure competitive third-party funding, and contribute to teaching at all levels-including student instruction, thesis supervision, and the mentorship of early-career researchers-is essential.

The appointee is expected to strengthen existing collaborations within the hospital and with external research institutions. In particular, the role involves fostering interdisciplinary collaboration and further developing the existing Clinical Neuroscience Center in close partnership with the Department of Neurosurgery and the Department of Neuroradiology.

The University of Zurich offers exceptional conditions for cutting-edge medical research. With its four university hospitals, the University of Zurich provides access to extensive patient populations, interdisciplinary research networks, and clinical expertise across all age groups and specialties. Its proximity to ETH Zurich offers additional opportunities for collaboration in computational medicine, bioengineering, data science, and AI-driven medicine. As a result, the Zurich location offers a translational ecosystem that spans from basic re-search to clinical application. The Neuroscience Center Zurich (ZNZ) provides excellent opportunities for networking with basic neuroscience groups at the University of Zurich and ETH Zurich.

German language skills at level B2 of the common European framework of reference for languages should be available or must be acquired within a reasonable period of time.

The University of Zurich is an equal opportunities employer and in particular strives to increase the percentage of women in leading positions. Therefore, qualified female researchers are encouraged to apply.

The University of Zurich sees researchers as modern leadership personalities who conduct excellent research - taking into account the Open Science principles - through their own research projects, promote excellent young researchers and who help to shape a forward-looking university with innovative research-based teaching.

Wir bieten:
Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers .

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste des ressources humaines

jobs.description:
Als grösste Universität der Schweiz bietet die Universität Zürich eine Vielzahl von attraktiven Positionen in verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Berufsfeldern. Mit rund 10'000 Mitarbeitenden und aktuell 12 Berufsprofilen für Lernende bietet die Universität ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld in der Spitzenforschung und Bildung. Setzen Sie Ihr Talent und Ihre Fähigkeiten bei uns ein. Erfahren Sie mehr über die UZH als Arbeitgeberin!

Aufgaben:
In Ihrer Rolle als HR-Fachperson 60-70% sind Sie die zentrale Ansprechperson für HR-Themen in den Bereichen Pflege und Stab. Sie bearbeiten die administrativen Personalprozesse entlang des gesamten Employee Lifecycles eigenständig – von der Rekrutierung über den Eintritt bis zum Austritt. Darüber hinaus unterstützen Sie Führungskräfte und Mitarbeitende in allen personalrelevanten Fragen.

Das Aufgabengebiet umfasst zudem folgende Tätigkeiten:
• Unterstützung und Beratung von Vorgesetzten und Mitarbeitenden bei allen Fragen zu Anstellungsbedingungen, Sozialversicherungen und Personalrecht

• Regelmässige HR-Auswertungen, Budget und Forecast der geplanten Stellen, Abrechnen von Zulagen, Verfassen von Arbeitszeugnissen und Absenzen-Management

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Controlling, der zentralen Personalabteilung der UZH und verschiedenen Behörden

Anforderungen:
Sie überzeugen durch sicheres Auftreten und mit folgenden Qualifikationen:
• Eine Kaufmännische Grundausbildung inkl. Weiterbildung als Personalassisten:in oder Personalfachperson mit FA zwingend

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Personalwesen in vergleichbarer Position; Erfahrung im Personalrecht des Kantons Zürich von Vorteil

• Gute Kenntnisse im Bereich Arbeitsbewilligungen, Sozialversicherungen und BVG

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS-Office Anwendungen, Anwendungskenntnisse in SAP HCM und Polypoint PEP von Vorteil

• Deutsche Muttersprache und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Ein ausgeprägter Dienstleitungsgrad, präzise Arbeitsweise und hohe Selbstorganisation helfen Ihnen ebenso wie eine positive Grundeinstellung

• Hohe Sozialkompetenz, teamorientiertes Handeln, Flexibilität und Belastbarkeit runden Ihr Profil ab

Es erwartet Sie eine anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem sehr dynamischen Betrieb. Die Besoldung richtet sich nach dem kantonalen Personalrecht. Sie profitieren ausserdem von attraktiven Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und diversen Vergünstigungen.

Wir bieten:
Unsere Mitarbeitenden profitieren von vielfältigen und attraktiven Angeboten. Erfahre mehr unter: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

jobs.title: Staff Mass Spectrometrist

titleByLocale.fr: Spectrométriste de masse du personnel

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
• You operate and maintain the mass spectrometry infrastructure, including Orbitrap Astral instruments and supporting LC systems, ensuring consistently high performance.

• Coordination, preparation, and processing of biological samples for stable isotope tracing, metabolomics, epitranscriptomics, and other MS-omics analyses - including low-input and single-cell samples - are part of your responsibilities.

• You support the implementation of automated sample preparation pipelines to increase throughput and improve reproducibility.

• Hands-on guidance and training of students and postdocs in the use of the instruments is an important part of your role.

• You actively contribute to the development and optimization of LC-MS methods for metabolite quantification, isotope enrichment, lipid profiling, and modified nucleotides.

• Routine instrument calibration, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance are carried out by you independently.

• You support data acquisition as well as initial QC and processing pipelines.

• You perform MS data processing and analysis across applications and collaborative projects, ensuring high data quality and consistency.

• You manage MS data across projects to ensure traceability, organization, and -reproducibility.

• You also help manage consumables, sample logistics, and platform documentation.

Anforderungen:
• Expert (MSc or PhD) in analytical chemistry, biochemistry, or a related field

• Solid practical experience with LC-MS/MS - ideally on Orbitrap-based instruments

• Background in stable isotope tracing and/or metabolomics in a biological setting is strongly preferred

• Interest in or experience with laboratory automation - liquid handling, automated sample prep, or scripted workflows

• Curiosity about emerging technologies, particularly single-cell mass spectrometry, is a genuine plus

• Methodical, detail-oriented, and comfortable troubleshooting complex instrument issues

• Able to work independently and communicate clearly with researchers at all levels

• Experience in a core facility, CRO, or research lab environment is valued

• English required; German is a plus

Wir bieten:
Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engagement Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable principal de la mobilisation en matière d'IA

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
• Act as a high-credibility external representative of UZH.ai in the Swiss and European AI ecosystem (federal and cantonal actors, funding agencies, startup hubs, industry associations, international AI initiatives).

• Map and regularly update UZH.ai on strategically relevant AI policy processes, funding programmes, and large-scale infrastructure initiatives (Swiss, EU, international), highlighting concrete opportunities and risks.

• Represent UZH and coordinate its presence at key AI policy events, working groups, and ecosystem fora (digitalswitzerland, federal AI groups, Geneva AI governance fora, etc.)

• Lead preparation and delivery of UZH's engagement at high-profile events such as the Global AI Summit 2027 (programme contributions, side events, delegation, and messaging), together with UZH leadership and the Digital Strategy Board.

• Identify and orchestrate UZH participation in large AI consortia and infrastructure initiatives (including “CERN-for-AI”-type proposals), coordinating faculty contributions internally.

• Drive 2–3 priority external funding applications per year, leading the political, ecosystem, and stake-holder-engagement components in collaboration with PIs, UZH.ai, DSI, and the UZH Research Office.

• Provide short, structured, and occasionally time-critical briefings to the Digital Strategy Board and UZH leadership, including clear recommendations.

• Support UZH.ai's positioning in national and international AI collaborations with other universities, public bodies, and industry.

Anforderungen:
We are looking for a Senior AI Engagement Lead to act as a highly credible, externally visible figurehead for UZH.ai in the Swiss AI ecosystem and key international fora. You will operate at the interface of academia, startups, industry, and policy-making, using your personal track record and network to open doors, build alliances, and help position UZH as a shaping voice in AI strategy, funding, and ecosystem development.
This is not a communications role. You will operate at the interface of academia, policy, and the AI ecosystem: building relationships with federal and cantonal actors, international AI initiatives, and funding bodies; preparing UZH's presence at key AI policy fora including the Global AI Summit 2027; and driving a pipeline of external grants and consortia. You are motivated by impact on the ecosystem and public good and will work closely with the UZH.ai Project Lead, the Digital Strategy Board, and UZH leadership.
Typical backgrounds we are particularly interested in:
• UZH (or other Swiss university) alumni who have founded, scaled, and successfully exited a tech startup, and now want to give back to the Swiss AI ecosystem.

• Senior ecosystem or policy leaders with 10–15+ years of relevant experience who wish to take on a strategic, part-time role alongside other activities.

• Master's degree or PhD, ideally from UZH or another Swiss university, in a relevant field (e.g. computer science, data science, engineering, economics, law, political science).
 Either:
• You have founded and scaled a tech or AI-related startup and successfully exited (trade sale, IPO, or equivalent), or

• You have at least 10–15 years of experience in senior roles in AI-related policy, ecosystem development, strategic stakeholder engagement, or research/innovation funding.

• A strong personal network in Swiss and/or European AI policy, government, research funding, and/or startup and innovation circles, with a track record of using that network to get things done.

• Deep understanding of how government policies, regulation, and funding instruments influence startup and scale-up success, ideally based on your own founder or investor experience.

• Proven ability to operate in politically sensitive, multi-stakeholder environments: you can align interests, negotiate trade-offs, and quietly unlock solutions without damaging relationships.

• Credible independent voice: you are comfortable representing UZH in senior fora, shaping narratives, and saying “no” when needed.

• Strategic and structured working style: you prioritise for impact, communicate clearly in writing and speech, and deliver without micro-management.

• Familiarity with Swiss higher education and research funding structures is a strong asset.

• Genuine motivation to strengthen the AI ecosystem in Switzerland and to support excellent, responsible AI research.

Wir bieten:
Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

Metti il tuo talento e le tue capacità per lavorare con noi. Scopri di più su UZH come datore di lavoro! Aufgaben:
• Atto come rappresentante esterno ad alta fattibilità dell'UZH.ai nell'ecosistema dell'AI svizzero ed europeo (attori federali e cantonali, agenzie di finanziamento, hub di startup, associazioni di settore, iniziative AI internazionali).
• Mappa e aggiorna regolarmente UZH.ai sui processi strategici di policy AI, programmi di finanziamento e iniziative infrastrutturali su larga scala (Swiss, EU, international), evidenziando opportunità e rischi concreti.
• Rappresentare UZH e coordinare la sua presenza in importanti eventi politici AI, gruppi di lavoro e fora di ecosistema (digitalswitzerland, gruppi di AI federali, Ginevra AI governance fora, ecc.)
• Preparazione e consegna del coinvolgimento di UZH in eventi di alto profilo come il Global AI Summit 2027 (contributi di programma, eventi collaterali, delegazione e messaggistica), insieme alla leadership UZH e il Digital Strategy Board.
• Identificare e orchestrare la partecipazione UZH a grandi consorzi AI e iniziative infrastrutturali (comprese le proposte di tipo “CERN-for-AI”), coordinando i contributi docenti internamente.
• Guidare le applicazioni di finanziamento esterno prioritarie 2–3 all'anno, guidando i componenti politici, ecosistemici e azionisti in collaborazione con PIs, UZH.ai, DSI e l'UZH Research Office.
• Fornire brevi, strutturati e occasionalmente briefing critico-tempo per il Digital Strategy Board e la leadership UZH, comprese le raccomandazioni chiare.
• Sostenere il posizionamento di UZH.ai in collaborazioni AI nazionali e internazionali con altre università, enti pubblici e industria. Potrai operare all'interfaccia di accademia, startup, industria e policy-making, utilizzando il tuo record personale di traccia e rete per aprire porte, costruire alleanze, e aiutare a posizionare UZH come voce di modellazione nella strategia di AI, il finanziamento e lo sviluppo dell'ecosistema. Questo non è un ruolo di comunicazione. Potrai operare all'interfaccia dell'accademia, della politica e dell'ecosistema dell'AI: costruire relazioni con attori federali e cantonali, iniziative internazionali dell'IA e organismi di finanziamento; preparare la presenza dell'UZH nella politica chiave dell'AI fora tra cui il Global AI Summit 2027; e guidare una pipeline di sovvenzioni esterne e consorzi. Sei motivato dall'impatto sull'ecosistema e sul bene pubblico e lavorerai a stretto contatto con il Project Lead UZH.ai, il Digital Strategy Board e la leadership UZH. Sfondi tipici siamo particolarmente interessati a:
• UZH (o altre università svizzere) ex alunni che hanno fondato, scalato e uscito con successo da una startup tecnologica, e ora vogliono restituire all'ecosistema svizzero AI.
• Senior ecosistema o leader politici con 10-15 anni di esperienza rilevante che desiderano assumere un ruolo strategico e part-time insieme ad altre attività.
• Laurea magistrale o dottorato, idealmente da UZH o un'altra università svizzera, in un campo rilevante (ad esempio informatica, scienza dei dati, ingegneria, economia, diritto, scienze politiche). O:
• Hai fondato e scalato una startup legata alla tecnologia o all'intelligenza artificiale e sei uscito con successo (vendita commerciale, IPO, o equivalente), o
• Hai almeno 10–15 anni di esperienza nei ruoli senior nella politica legata all'intelligenza artificiale, nello sviluppo degli ecosistemi, nell'impegno strategico delle parti interessate o nel finanziamento della ricerca/innovazione.
• Una forte rete personale nella politica dell'AI svizzera e/o europea, nel governo, nel finanziamento della ricerca e/o nei circoli di startup e innovazione, con un track record di utilizzo di quella rete per fare le cose.
• La profonda comprensione di come le politiche governative, la regolamentazione e gli strumenti di finanziamento influenzano il successo di startup e scale-up, idealmente basato sulla propria esperienza di fondatore o investitore.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
• Act as a high-credibility external representative of UZH.ai in the Swiss and European AI ecosystem (federal and cantonal actors, funding agencies, startup hubs, industry associations, international AI initiatives).

• Map and regularly update UZH.ai on strategically relevant AI policy processes, funding programmes, and large-scale infrastructure initiatives (Swiss, EU, international), highlighting concrete opportunities and risks.

• Represent UZH and coordinate its presence at key AI policy events, working groups, and ecosystem fora (digitalswitzerland, federal AI groups, Geneva AI governance fora, etc.)

• Lead preparation and delivery of UZH's engagement at high-profile events such as the Global AI Summit 2027 (programme contributions, side events, delegation, and messaging), together with UZH leadership and the Digital Strategy Board.

• Identify and orchestrate UZH participation in large AI consortia and infrastructure initiatives (including “CERN-for-AI”-type proposals), coordinating faculty contributions internally.

• Drive 2–3 priority external funding applications per year, leading the political, ecosystem, and stake-holder-engagement components in collaboration with PIs, UZH.ai, DSI, and the UZH Research Office.

• Provide short, structured, and occasionally time-critical briefings to the Digital Strategy Board and UZH leadership, including clear recommendations.

• Support UZH.ai's positioning in national and international AI collaborations with other universities, public bodies, and industry.

Anforderungen:
We are looking for a Senior AI Engagement Lead to act as a highly credible, externally visible figurehead for UZH.ai in the Swiss AI ecosystem and key international fora. You will operate at the interface of academia, startups, industry, and policy-making, using your personal track record and network to open doors, build alliances, and help position UZH as a shaping voice in AI strategy, funding, and ecosystem development.
This is not a communications role. You will operate at the interface of academia, policy, and the AI ecosystem: building relationships with federal and cantonal actors, international AI initiatives, and funding bodies; preparing UZH's presence at key AI policy fora including the Global AI Summit 2027; and driving a pipeline of external grants and consortia. You are motivated by impact on the ecosystem and public good and will work closely with the UZH.ai Project Lead, the Digital Strategy Board, and UZH leadership.
Typical backgrounds we are particularly interested in:
• UZH (or other Swiss university) alumni who have founded, scaled, and successfully exited a tech startup, and now want to give back to the Swiss AI ecosystem.

• Senior ecosystem or policy leaders with 10–15+ years of relevant experience who wish to take on a strategic, part-time role alongside other activities.

• Master's degree or PhD, ideally from UZH or another Swiss university, in a relevant field (e.g. computer science, data science, engineering, economics, law, political science).
Either:
• You have founded and scaled a tech or AI-related startup and successfully exited (trade sale, IPO, or equivalent), or

• You have at least 10–15 years of experience in senior roles in AI-related policy, ecosystem development, strategic stakeholder engagement, or research/innovation funding.

• A strong personal network in Swiss and/or European AI policy, government, research funding, and/or startup and innovation circles, with a track record of using that network to get things done.

• Deep understanding of how government policies, regulation, and funding instruments influence startup and scale-up success, ideally based on your own founder or investor experience.

• Proven ability to operate in politically sensitive, multi-stakeholder environments: you can align interests, negotiate trade-offs, and quietly unlock solutions without damaging relationships.

• Credible independent voice: you are comfortable representing UZH in senior fora, shaping narratives, and saying “no” when needed.

• Strategic and structured working style: you prioritise for impact, communicate clearly in writing and speech, and deliver without micro-management.

• Familiarity with Swiss higher education and research funding structures is a strong asset.

• Genuine motivation to strengthen the AI ecosystem in Switzerland and to support excellent, responsible AI research.

Wir bieten:
Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

• Master-Abschluss oder PhD, idealerweise von der UZH oder einer anderen Schweizer Universität, in einem relevanten Bereich (z.B. Informatik, Data Science, Ingenieurwesen, Wirtschaft, Recht, Politikwissenschaft). Entweder:

• Sie verfügen über mindestens 10-15 Jahre Erfahrung in leitenden Funktionen in der KI-bezogenen Politik, der Ökosystementwicklung, dem strategischen Stakeholder-Engagement oder der Forschungs- / Innovationsfinanzierung.
• Ein starkes persönliches Netzwerk in Schweizer und / oder europäischen KI-Politik, Regierung, Forschungsfinanzierung und / oder Startup- und Innovationskreisen, mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Nutzung dieses Netzwerks, um Dinge zu erledigen.
• Tiefes Verständnis dafür, wie Regierungspolitik, Regulierung und Finanzierungsinstrumente den Start- und Scale-up-Erfolg beeinflussen, idealerweise basierend auf Ihrer eigenen Gründer- oder Investorenerfahrung.
• Bewährte Fähigkeit, in politisch sensiblen, Multi-Stakeholder-Umgebungen zu agieren: Sie können Interessen in Einklang bringen, Kompromisse aushandeln und Lösungen in aller Stille freischalten, ohne Beziehungen zu schädigen.
• Glaubwürdige unabhängige Stimme: Es ist Ihnen angenehm, die UZH in leitenden Foren zu vertreten, Narrative zu gestalten und bei Bedarf "Nein" zu sagen.
• Strategischer und strukturierter Arbeitsstil: Sie priorisieren Wirkung, kommunizieren schriftlich und redlich klar und liefern ohne Mikromanagement.
• Die Vertrautheit mit Schweizer Hochschul- und Forschungsfinanzierungsstrukturen ist ein großer Gewinn.
• Echte Motivation, das KI-Ökosystem in der Schweiz zu stärken und exzellente, verantwortungsvolle KI-Forschung zu unterstützen. Wir bieten: Unsere Mitarbeiter profitieren von einer breiten Palette attraktiver Angebote. Weitere Informationen finden Sie unter https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

• Représenter l'UZH et coordonner sa présence lors d'événements stratégiques clés sur l'IA, de groupes de travail et de forums sur les écosystèmes (numériqueswitzerland, groupes d'IA fédéraux, forums de gouvernance de Genève sur l'IA, etc.)
• Diriger la préparation et l'exécution de l'engagement de l'UZH lors d'événements très médiatisés tels que le Sommet mondial de l'IA 2027 (contributions au programme, manifestations parallèles, délégation et messagerie), ainsi que les dirigeants de l'UZH et le Conseil de stratégie numérique.
• Identifier et orchestrer la participation de l'UZH à de grands consortiums d'IA et à des initiatives d'infrastructure (y compris des propositions de type CERN pour l'AI), en coordonnant les contributions du corps professoral en interne.
• Diriger 2 à 3 demandes de financement externe prioritaires par année, en dirigeant les composantes politiques, écosystémiques et d'engagement des intervenants, en collaboration avec les IP, UZH.ai, DSI et le Bureau de recherche de l'UZH.
• Fournir des séances d'information brèves, structurées et parfois critiques sur le temps au Conseil de stratégie numérique et aux dirigeants de l'UZH, y compris des recommandations claires.
• Soutenir le positionnement d'UZH.ai dans les collaborations nationales et internationales avec d'autres universités, organismes publics et industrie. - C'est pas vrai. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Senior AI Engagement Lead pour agir comme une figure de choix hautement crédible et visible pour UZH.ai dans l'écosystème suisse de l'IA et des forums internationaux clés. Contextes typiques qui nous intéressent particulièrement :

• Chefs de file en matière d'écosystème ou de politiques ayant plus de 10 à 15 ans d'expérience pertinente qui souhaitent jouer un rôle stratégique à temps partiel en plus d'autres activités.
• Maîtrise ou doctorat, idéalement de l'UZH ou d'une autre université suisse, dans un domaine pertinent (p. ex. informatique, data science, ingénierie, économie, droit, sciences politiques). Soit:
• Vous avez fondé et mis à l'échelle une startup liée à la technologie ou à l'IA et avez réussi à sortir (vente commerciale, IPO ou équivalent), ou
• Vous disposez d'au moins 10 à 15 ans d'expérience dans les rôles supérieurs dans les politiques liées à l'IA, le développement des écosystèmes, la participation des intervenants stratégiques ou le financement de la recherche et de l'innovation.
• Un solide réseau personnel dans la politique suisse et/ou européenne de l'IA, le gouvernement, le financement de la recherche, et/ou les cercles de démarrage et d'innovation, avec une expérience d'utilisation de ce réseau pour faire les choses.

• Capacité éprouvée d'opérer dans des environnements politiquement sensibles et multipartites : vous pouvez aligner les intérêts, négocier des compromis et débloquer des solutions tranquillement sans nuire aux relations.
• Voix indépendante crédible : vous êtes à l'aise pour représenter l'UZH dans les forums seniors, façonner des narrations, et dire "no" au besoin.
• Style de travail stratégique et structuré : vous priorisez l'impact, vous communiquez clairement par écrit et par la parole, et vous livrez sans microgestion.
• La connaissance des structures suisses d'enseignement supérieur et de financement de la recherche est un atout important.
• Véritable motivation à renforcer l'écosystème de l'IA en Suisse et à soutenir une recherche excellente et responsable sur l'IA. - Oui. Nos employés bénéficient d'un large éventail d'offres attrayantes. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

Aufgaben:
Ihre Tätigkeit am Lehrstuhl richtet sich nach dem Stand Ihrer Ausbildung und Ihrem Profil. Sie umfasst die Mitarbeit in Forschung und Lehre, insbesondere die Vorbereitung von Lehrveranstaltungen (Materialien, Übungen) und Publikationen (Recherchen, Korrekturen) sowie die Unterstützung und Mitarbeit an Forschungsprojekten des Lehrstuhls. Hinzukommen kann, je nach Qualifikation und Beschäftigungsgrad, die Durchführung von Lehrveranstaltungen sowie die Betreuung von Studierenden. Ebenfalls möglich ist eine Mitwirkung bei der Vorbereitung und Korrektur von Prüfungen und bei der Betreuung von Bachelor-, Master- und Seminararbeiten.

Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt kann, ebenfalls abhängig von Ihrem Profil, die Mitarbeit an laufenden und die Mitentwicklung künftiger Projekte im Bereich der Legal Technology und der Digital Humanities sein. Dazu arbeiten Sie eng mit internen und externen Entwicklerteams zusammen, übersetzen juristische Fragestellungen in tragfähige konzeptionelle und technische Ansätze und begleiten den Entwicklungsprozess in fachlicher Verantwortung.

Eigene Projekte im Rahmen der Forschungsschwerpunkte des Lehrstuhls können nach Absprache selbständig durchgeführt werden.

Anforderungen:
Sie studieren Rechtswissenschaften im Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang oder haben das Studium bereits abgeschlossen und sich gegebenenfalls bereits weiter qualifiziert. Vorausgesetzt wird ein überdurchschnittlicher Leistungsausweis sowie die Bereitschaft, sich in die Lehr- und Forschungsbereiche des Lehrstuhls vertieft einzuarbeiten und selbständig zu arbeiten.

Erwünscht ist ein besonderes Interesse an Legal Tech und Digital Humanities oder die Bereitschaft, sich künftig vertieft mit diesen Themengebieten auseinanderzusetzen. Im Idealfall verfügen Sie neben sehr guten juristischen Kenntnissen auch über technische Kenntnisse.

Aufgrund der engen Zusammenarbeit des Lehrstuhls mit internationalen Forschungsnetzwerken und Universitäten im Ausland sind neben sehr guten Deutschkenntnissen Fremdsprachenkenntnisse sehr willkommen.

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
The successful candidate will work under the supervision of Prof. Helena Hof, Principal Investigator of the SNF Starting Grant project “Provisional Futures: Migrants as wanted workers, yet temporary residents” and SNF Assistant Professor at the Department. The Postdoc will be responsible for one of the two field sites (Canada or Japan) within the project and will collaborate with the project team as well as with the overseas host institution throughout the research project. This role requires someone equally comfortable leading independent fieldwork abroad and contributing actively to a tightly collaborative, multi-sited research team.

The successful candidate will lead the Work Package Canada or Japan , conducting an ethnographically-informed study of temporary labour migration in the three sectors IT, health care, and construction. This will include in-depth interviews with migrant workers, ethnographic observations at their workplaces and socializing activities, as well as stakeholder interviews with employers, policy makers, representatives of unions, and of migrant support organizations. The position is based at the Department of Social Anthropology and Cultural Studies at the University of Zurich and requires residency in Switzerland. Data will be collected over two extended periods of field research in Canada / Japan, where the postdoc will be hosted by the overseas collaborating institutions, the Global Migration Institute, Toronto Metropolitan University, Canada and the Institute of Asian Migrations, Waseda University, Japan, respectively. This will allow the postdoc to broaden their academic networks and produce both single-authored articles and collaborative research outputs and thereby establish their own independent research profile.

The team collaborates on project preparation and analysis as well as co-authorship. The two postdocs are expected to provide guidance to the research assistant and the PhD researcher in the team, and benefit from free trainings and courses offered at UZH. This allows them to take over greater responsibilities over time and develop mentoring and leadership skills.

Compensation: The salary is based on rates set by the Swiss National Science Foundation: Annex_XII_Ausfuehrungsreglement_Beitragsreglement_E.pdf

Your tasks

Independent:
• Design and carry out your own work package.

• Conduct extended fieldwork in Canada/Japan.

• Publications in migration studies and disciplinary journals.

Collaborative:
• Contribute to joint theory-building at the intersection of migration studies, research on socio-cultural diversification and theorizations of future work.

• Collaborate within an ambitious, international, and interdisciplinary research team.

• Serve as co-guest-editor for a Special Issue in a major journal in the field.

• Co-organize a stakeholder workshop in the country of your expertise.

• Informal mentorship of the PhD student and the Research Assistant.

Anforderungen:
Applicants must, at the time of assuming employment, hold a PhD in Anthropology, Sociology, Geography, Migration Studies, or a related social science discipline with a strong focus on migration and mobility.

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

• Knowledge in the fields of temporary migration, immigrant integration, and labour market institutions in Canada / Japan.

• Strong qualitative research skills, including experience conducting in-depth interviews and ethnographic observations.

• Solid training in anthropology or other relevant theoretical approaches of the social sciences.

• Postdoc Japan: Demonstrated fluency in spoken and written Japanese.

• Strong academic writing and publication skills.

• Excellent organizational, communication, and event coordination skills.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and timelines.

The following are considered assets:

• Experience with academic management, scientific outreach and creative methods.

• Knowledge of the migratory landscape in IT, health care and construction in Canada or Japan.

• Training and experience in comparative research.

• International research experience.

The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
The successful candidate will work under the supervision of Prof. Helena Hof, Principal Investigator of the SNF Starting Grant project “Provisional Futures: Migrants as wanted workers, yet temporary residents” and SNF Assistant Professor at the Department. The Postdoc will be responsible for one of the two field sites (Canada or Japan) within the project and will collaborate with the project team as well as with the overseas host institution throughout the research project. This role requires someone equally comfortable leading independent fieldwork abroad and contributing actively to a tightly collaborative, multi-sited research team.

The successful candidate will lead the Work Package Canada or Japan , conducting an ethnographically-informed study of temporary labour migration in the three sectors IT, health care, and construction. This will include in-depth interviews with migrant workers, ethnographic observations at their workplaces and socializing activities, as well as stakeholder interviews with employers, policy makers, representatives of unions, and of migrant support organizations. The position is based at the Department of Social Anthropology and Cultural Studies at the University of Zurich and requires residency in Switzerland. Data will be collected over two extended periods of field research in Canada / Japan, where the postdoc will be hosted by the overseas collaborating institutions, the Global Migration Institute, Toronto Metropolitan University, Canada and the Institute of Asian Migrations, Waseda University, Japan, respectively. This will allow the postdoc to broaden their academic networks and produce both single-authored articles and collaborative research outputs and thereby establish their own independent research profile.

The team collaborates on project preparation and analysis as well as co-authorship. The two postdocs are expected to provide guidance to the research assistant and the PhD researcher in the team, and benefit from free trainings and courses offered at UZH. This allows them to take over greater responsibilities over time and develop mentoring and leadership skills.

Compensation: The salary is based on rates set by the Swiss National Science Foundation: Annex_XII_Ausfuehrungsreglement_Beitragsreglement_E.pdf

Your tasks

Independent:
• Design and carry out your own work package.

• Conduct extended fieldwork in Canada/Japan.

• Publications in migration studies and disciplinary journals.

Collaborative:
• Contribute to joint theory-building at the intersection of migration studies, research on socio-cultural diversification and theorizations of future work.

• Collaborate within an ambitious, international, and interdisciplinary research team.

• Serve as co-guest-editor for a Special Issue in a major journal in the field.

• Co-organize a stakeholder workshop in the country of your expertise.

• Informal mentorship of the PhD student and the Research Assistant.

Anforderungen:
Applicants must, at the time of assuming employment, hold a PhD in Anthropology, Sociology, Geography, Migration Studies, or a related social science discipline with a strong focus on migration and mobility.

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

• Knowledge in the fields of temporary migration, immigrant integration, and labour market institutions in Canada / Japan.

• Strong qualitative research skills, including experience conducting in-depth interviews and ethnographic observations.

• Solid training in anthropology or other relevant theoretical approaches of the social sciences.

• Postdoc Japan: Demonstrated fluency in spoken and written Japanese.

• Strong academic writing and publication skills.

• Excellent organizational, communication, and event coordination skills.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and timelines.

The following are considered assets:

• Experience with academic management, scientific outreach and creative methods.

• Knowledge of the migratory landscape in IT, health care and construction in Canada or Japan.

• Training and experience in comparative research.

• International research experience.

• Fluency in languages other than English.

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
Within the SNSF project, the EcoVision Lab will focus on advancing forest parameter estimation, particularly canopy height, at the most detailed level. As a PhD candidate, you will develop novel deep learning and computer vision methods to transform large-scale remote sensing imagery of different satellite missions to maps of canopy height, and further forest parameters and their change over time.

Your research will include:
• Developing deep learning models for satellite image time-series analysis and domain adaption

• Developing deep learning models for (guided) super-resolution of historical satellite imagery

• Producing calibrated uncertainty estimates for all model outputs

• Training models on heterogeneous data sources (e.g., Landsat, Sentinel-2, SPOT, Corona) and exploring multimodal combinations of different data sources.

Research Freedom & Methodological Innovation

The project offers significant freedom to explore impactful methodological directions in modern AI, including: self-supervised learning, multimodal learning, (guided) super-resolution, uncertainty estimation, time-series regression. We aim for high-impact publications both in machine learning venues (e.g., CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, ICLR, NeurIPS) and leading interdisciplinary journals such as Remote Sensing of Environment, ISPRS Journal, and Nature Sustainability.

Why Join?

These 2x PhD positions offer:

• Become part of the EcoVision Lab, a vibrant, exciting, fun place to do research on deep learning for applications to ecology

• Close collaborations with leading research groups in machine learning, computer vision, data science, remote sensing, and historical remote sensing image interpretation.

• A unique opportunity to combine cutting-edge AI research with real-world environmental impact for a yet completely under-explored research topic

• Access to diverse, large-scale historical satellite image archives

Anforderungen:
We are looking for highly motivated candidates who are excited about pushing the boundaries of machine learning while contributing to meaningful environmental impact.
You are curious, rigorous, and enjoy developing both new ideas and high-quality research software. You are comfortable engaging with challenging problems and collaborating across disciplines.

An ideal candidate will have:

• An excellent Master's degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a closely related field (e.g., Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics)

• A strong foundation in mathematics and machine learning

• A lot of programming experience, preferably in Python

• Strong prior experience in deep learning and computer vision

• Interest in applying advanced ML methods to ecological and geospatial data

• Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required

Experience with topics such as self-supervised learning, domain adaption, transfer learning, multimodal learning, uncertainty estimation is a plus - but not strictly required.
We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive research environment. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and particularly welcome those who may not meet every listed criterion but bring strong motivation and potential.

Wir bieten:
Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

Come candidato PhD, svilupperai nuovi metodi di apprendimento profondo e visione del computer per trasformare immagini telerilevamento su larga scala di diverse missioni satellitari a mappe di altezza del baldacchino, e ulteriori parametri della foresta e il loro cambiamento nel tempo. La vostra ricerca comprenderà:
• Sviluppare modelli di apprendimento approfonditi per l'analisi della serie di immagini satellitari e l'adattamento del dominio
• Sviluppare modelli di apprendimento profondo per (guida) super-risoluzione di immagini satellitari storiche
• Produrre stime di incertezza calibrate per tutte le uscite del modello
• Modelli di formazione su fonti di dati eterogenee (ad esempio, Landsat, Sentinel-2, SPOT, Corona) e l'esplorazione di combinazioni multimodali di diverse fonti di dati. Ricerca Libertà e innovazione metodologica Il progetto offre una notevole libertà di esplorare direzioni metodologiche d'impatto nella moderna AI, tra cui: apprendimento self-supervised, apprendimento multimodale, (guida) super-risoluzione, stima dell'incertezza, regressione della serie temporale. Ci proponiamo di pubblicazioni ad alto impatto sia nei luoghi di apprendimento automatico (ad esempio, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, ICLR, NeurIPS) che nelle principali riviste interdisciplinari come il rilevamento remoto dell'ambiente, ISPRS Journal e la sostenibilità della natura. Perché unirsi? Queste posizioni 2x PhD offrono:
• Diventa parte del EcoVision Lab, un luogo vibrante, emozionante e divertente per fare ricerca sull'apprendimento approfondito per applicazioni in ecologia
• Chiudere le collaborazioni con i principali gruppi di ricerca nell'apprendimento automatico, nella visione del computer, nella scienza dei dati, nel telerilevamento e nell'interpretazione storica dell'immagine a distanza.
• Un'opportunità unica per combinare la ricerca AI all'avanguardia con l'impatto ambientale del mondo reale per un argomento di ricerca ancora completamente inesplorato
• Accesso a diversi archivi di immagini satellitari storici su larga scala Anforderungen: Siamo alla ricerca di candidati altamente motivati che sono entusiasti di spingere i confini di machine learning, contribuendo al significativo impatto ambientale. Siete curiosi, rigorosi e godere di sviluppare sia nuove idee e software di ricerca di alta qualità. Sei a tuo agio ad affrontare problemi impegnativi e a collaborare tra le discipline. Un candidato ideale avrà:
• Un eccellente master (M.Sc. o equivalente) in Informatica, Machine Learning, Data Science, o un campo strettamente correlato (ad esempio, ingegneria elettrica, matematica applicata)
• Una forte fondazione in matematica e machine learning
• Un sacco di esperienza di programmazione, preferibilmente in Python
• Forte esperienza precedente nell'apprendimento profondo e nella visione del computer
• Interessi nell'applicazione di metodi ML avanzati ai dati ecologici e geospaziali
• La fluidità in inglese (scritta e parlata) è richiesta Esperienza con argomenti come l'apprendimento self-supervised, l'adattamento del dominio, l'apprendimento del trasferimento, l'apprendimento multimodale, la stima dell'incertezza è un plus - ma non strettamente richiesto. Ci impegniamo a costruire un ambiente di ricerca diversificato e inclusivo. Incoraggiamo le domande dei candidati di tutti gli sfondi e in particolare accogliamo coloro che non possono soddisfare ogni criterio elencato, ma portano forte motivazione e potenziale. Die Universität Zürich, die größte Universität der Schweiz, bietet eine Reihe attraktiver Positionen in verschiedenen Fachgebieten und Berufsfeldern. Mit rund 10.000 Mitarbeitern und derzeit 12 beruflichen Ausbildungsströmen bietet die Universität ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld für Spitzenforschung und erstklassige Bildung. Setzen Sie Ihr Talent und Ihre Fähigkeiten ein, um mit uns zu arbeiten. Erfahren Sie mehr über die UZH als Arbeitgeber! Aufgaben: Im Rahmen des SNF-Projekts wird sich das EcoVision Lab darauf konzentrieren, die Waldparameterschätzung, insbesondere die Baumkronenhöhe, auf der detailliertesten Ebene voranzutreiben. Als Doktorand werden Sie neuartige Deep Learning- und Computer Vision-Methoden entwickeln, um groß angelegte Fernerkundungsbilder verschiedener Satellitenmissionen in Karten der Baumkronenhöhe und weitere Waldparameter und deren Veränderung im Laufe der Zeit zu transformieren. Ihre Forschung umfasst:
• Entwicklung von Deep-Learning-Modellen für Satellitenbild-Zeitreihenanalyse und Domänenadaption
• Entwicklung von Deep-Learning-Modellen für (geführte) Superauflösung historischer Satellitenbilder
• Erstellung kalibrierter Unsicherheitsschätzungen für alle Modellergebnisse
• Trainingsmodelle zu heterogenen Datenquellen (z. B. Landsat, Sentinel-2, SPOT, Corona) und die Erforschung multimodaler Kombinationen verschiedener Datenquellen. Forschungsfreiheit und methodische Innovation Das Projekt bietet erhebliche Freiheiten, um wirkungsvolle methodische Richtungen in der modernen KI zu erforschen, darunter: selbstüberwachtes Lernen, multimodales Lernen, (geführte) Superauflösung, Unsicherheitsschätzung, Zeitreihenregression. Unser Ziel sind wirkungsvolle Veröffentlichungen sowohl in Orten des maschinellen Lernens (z. B. CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, ICLR, NeurIPS) als auch in führenden interdisziplinären Zeitschriften wie Remote Sensing of Environment, ISPRS Journal und Nature Sustainability. Warum beitreten? Diese 2x PhD Positionen bieten:
• Werden Sie Teil des EcoVision Lab, einem lebendigen, aufregenden und unterhaltsamen Ort, um Deep Learning für Anwendungen in der Ökologie zu erforschen
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit führenden Forschungsgruppen in den Bereichen maschinelles Lernen, Computer Vision, Data Science, Fernerkundung und historische Fernerkundungsbildinterpretation.
• Eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, innovative KI-Forschung mit realen Umweltauswirkungen für ein noch völlig unerforschtes Forschungsthema zu kombinieren
• Zugang zu diversen, groß angelegten historischen Satellitenbildarchiven Anforderungen: Wir suchen hochmotivierte Kandidaten, die sich dafür begeistern, die Grenzen des maschinellen Lernens zu erweitern und gleichzeitig zu sinnvollen Umweltauswirkungen beizutragen. Sie sind neugierig, streng und entwickeln gerne neue Ideen und hochwertige Forschungssoftware. Sie beschäftigen sich gerne mit herausfordernden Problemen und arbeiten disziplinübergreifend zusammen. Ein idealer Kandidat hat:
• Ein exzellenter Master-Abschluss (M.Sc. oder gleichwertig) in Informatik, Machine Learning, Data Science oder einem eng verwandten Bereich (z. B. Elektrotechnik, Angewandte Mathematik)
• Eine starke Grundlage in Mathematik und maschinellem Lernen
• Viel Programmiererfahrung, vorzugsweise in Python
• Starke Vorkenntnisse in Deep Learning und Computer Vision
• Interesse an der Anwendung fortschrittlicher ML-Methoden auf ökologische und geospatiale Daten
• Fließend in Englisch (geschrieben und gesprochen) ist erforderlich Erfahrung mit Themen wie selbstüberwachtem Lernen, Domänenadaption, Transferlernen, multimodalem Lernen, Unsicherheitsschätzung ist ein Plus - aber nicht unbedingt erforderlich. Wir engagieren uns für den Aufbau eines vielfältigen und integrativen Forschungsumfelds. Wir empfehlen Bewerbungen von Kandidaten aller Herkunft und begrüßen insbesondere diejenigen, die möglicherweise nicht alle aufgeführten Kriterien erfüllen, aber eine starke Motivation und Potenzial mitbringen. Mettez votre talent et vos compétences au travail avec nous. En savoir plus sur UZH en tant qu'employeur! Aufgaben: Dans le cadre du projet SNSF, EcoVision Lab s'attachera à faire progresser l'estimation des paramètres forestiers, en particulier la hauteur du couvert, au niveau le plus détaillé. En tant que candidat au doctorat, vous développerez de nouvelles méthodes d'apprentissage profond et de vision informatique pour transformer l'imagerie de télédétection à grande échelle de différentes missions satellitaires en cartes de hauteur du couvert, ainsi que d'autres paramètres forestiers et leur évolution au fil du temps. Votre recherche comprendra :
• Développer des modèles d'apprentissage profond pour l'analyse des séries chronologiques d'images satellitaires et l'adaptation des domaines
• Mise au point de modèles d'apprentissage approfondi pour la superrésolution (guide) de l'imagerie satellitaire historique
• Production d'estimations d'incertitude étalonnées pour toutes les sorties du modèle
• Des modèles de formation sur des sources de données hétérogènes (p. ex. Landsat, Sentinel-2, SPOT, Corona) et l'exploration de combinaisons multimodales de différentes sources de données. Liberté de la recherche et innovation méthodologique Le projet offre une grande liberté pour explorer les orientations méthodologiques impactées dans l'IA moderne, y compris: apprentissage autosupervisé, apprentissage multimodal, (guidé) super-résolution, estimation d'incertitude, régression de séries chronologiques. Nous visons des publications à fort impact à la fois dans des lieux d'apprentissage automatique (p. ex. CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, ICLR, NeurIPS) et des revues interdisciplinaires de pointe comme la télédétection de l'environnement, le Journal ISPRS et la durabilité de la nature. Pourquoi rejoindre ? Ces 2 postes de doctorat offrent :
• Devenez membre du laboratoire EcoVision, un endroit vibrant, excitant et amusant pour faire des recherches sur l'apprentissage profond pour les applications à l'écologie
• Collaboration étroite avec des groupes de recherche de premier plan dans les domaines de l'apprentissage automatique, de la vision informatique, de la science des données, de la télédétection et de l'interprétation historique des images de télédétection.
• Une occasion unique de combiner la recherche de pointe sur l'IA avec l'impact réel sur l'environnement pour un sujet de recherche encore complètement sous-exploré
• Accès à des archives d'images historiques à grande échelle - C'est pas vrai. Nous recherchons des candidats très motivés qui sont excités par le fait de repousser les limites de l'apprentissage automatique tout en contribuant à un impact environnemental significatif. Vous êtes curieux, rigoureux et aimez développer de nouvelles idées et des logiciels de recherche de haute qualité. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les problèmes difficiles et la collaboration entre les disciplines. Un candidat idéal aura :
• Un excellent diplôme de maîtrise (M.Sc. ou équivalent) en informatique, apprentissage automatique, science des données ou un domaine étroitement lié (p. ex., génie électrique, mathématiques appliquées)
• Une base solide en mathématiques et en apprentissage automatique
• Beaucoup d'expérience de programmation, de préférence en Python
• Forte expérience de l'apprentissage profond et de la vision informatique
• Intérêt pour l'application de méthodes avancées ML aux données écologiques et géospatiales
• La maîtrise de l'anglais (écrit et parlé) est requise Expérience de sujets tels que l'apprentissage autosupervisé, l'adaptation de domaine, l'apprentissage par transfert, l'apprentissage multimodal, l'estimation de l'incertitude est un plus - mais pas strictement nécessaire. Nous sommes déterminés à créer un environnement de recherche diversifié et inclusif. Nous encourageons les candidats de tous les horizons et nous souhaitons particulièrement la bienvenue à ceux qui ne répondent pas à tous les critères énumérés, mais qui apportent une forte motivation et un fort potentiel. - Oui. jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
• You conduct research projects in the field of law and economics, empirical legal studies, or legal data science. These projects will be part of a monographic or cumulative PhD dissertation.

• You explore legal problems (e.g. judicial decision-making, legal AI, Swiss public law, EU law, international law) ideally using empirical methods (e.g. observational or experimental data), or methods from economics or data science more broadly (e.g. machine learning, NLP).

• You are willing to integrate a highl international environment and contribute to intellectual debates at the Chair.

Anforderungen:
• You hold an excellent degree in law and optionally a degree in social science (e.g. economics, psychology), or in a related discipline. Applicants who do not hold a law degree need to demonstrate a keen interest in the law and interdisciplinary approaches to law.

• You have (ideally advanced) data analysis skills (e.g. using Python, R, Stata), or you are willing to invest in developing your data analysis skills.

• You have excellent analytical skills and are willing to collaborate on research projects at the Chair.

• You are proificient in English and ideally another language (e.g. German, French, Italian), and are motivated to contribute to research in a genuinely interdisciplinary and international environment.

Wir bieten:
Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
Building upon this earlier work you will:
• Perform field and greenhouse experiments testing under which conditions and with which plant species inoculation with AMF and further beneficial microbes promote crop yield.

• Use molecular tools (qPCR, metabarcoding) and microscopy to assess whether the inoculated microbes colonize soil and/or plant roots and establish in the field.

• contribute to data analysis and reporting.

• Publish results in high-impact, peer-reviewed journals.

Anforderungen:
• Master's degree in microbiology, agronomy, microbial ecology, microbiome research or botany with excellent grades.

• Expertise in one or several of the following themes: greenhouse or field experiments with plants, microbial ecology, fungi, bacteria, molecular and microbiological methods.

• Strong statistical skills would be an advantage

• An achievement-oriented and an open-minded personality with good capacity for teamwork. Willing to work in the field (harvest days are long and fun!)

• Swiss German is sometimes an advantage (e.g. to interact with farmers), but is not required. English is our working language.

• The university of Zurich is the largest university in Switzerland and has excellent facilities for research and teaching and it has an inspiring, open minded and social environment.

Wir bieten:
Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'Università di Zurigo, la più grande università della Svizzera, offre una gamma di posizioni attraenti in varie aree tematiche e campi professionali. Con circa 10.000 dipendenti e attualmente 12 corsi di apprendistato professionale, l'Università offre un ambiente di lavoro stimolante sulla ricerca all'avanguardia e sull'istruzione di prima classe. Metti il tuo talento e le tue capacità per lavorare con noi. Scopri di più su UZH come datore di lavoro!

Aufgaben:
Costruire su questo lavoro precedente sarà:
• Eseguire i test sul campo e sugli esperimenti a effetto serra in cui le condizioni e con quali specie vegetali inoculazione con AMF e ulteriori microbi benefici promuovono la resa delle colture.

• Utilizzare strumenti molecolari (qPCR, metabarcoding) e microscopia per valutare se i microbi inoculati colonizzano il suolo e/o le radici vegetali e stabiliscono nel campo.

• contribuire all'analisi e alla segnalazione dei dati.

• Pubblica i risultati in riviste ad alto impatto e peer-reviewed.

Anforderungen:
• Laurea magistrale in microbiologia, agronomia, ecologia microbica, ricerca microbioma o botanica con eccellenti gradi.

• Competenza in uno o più dei seguenti temi: esperimenti in serra o in campo con piante, ecologia microbica, funghi, batteri, metodi molecolari e microbiologici.

• Una forte capacità statistica sarebbe un vantaggio

• Una personalità orientata al raggiungimento e aperta con una buona capacità di lavoro di squadra. Volontà di lavorare nel campo (i giorni più belli sono lunghi e divertenti!)

• Il tedesco svizzero a volte è un vantaggio (ad esempio per interagire con gli agricoltori), ma non è necessario. L'inglese è la nostra lingua di lavoro.

• L'università di Zurigo è la più grande università in Svizzera e dispone di eccellenti strutture per la ricerca e l'insegnamento e ha un ambiente stimolante, aperto e sociale.

Wir bieten:
I nostri dipendenti beneficiano di una vasta gamma di offerte interessanti. Maggiori informazioni: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Universität Zürich, die größte Universität der Schweiz, bietet eine Reihe attraktiver Positionen in verschiedenen Fachgebieten und Berufsfeldern. Mit rund 10.000 Mitarbeitern und derzeit 12 beruflichen Ausbildungsströmen bietet die Universität ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld für Spitzenforschung und erstklassige Bildung. Setzen Sie Ihr Talent und Ihre Fähigkeiten ein, um mit uns zu arbeiten. Erfahren Sie mehr über die UZH als Arbeitgeber!

Aufgaben:
Aufbauend auf dieser früheren Arbeit werden Sie:
• Führen Sie Feld- und Gewächshausexperimente durch, bei denen geprüft wird, unter welchen Bedingungen und mit welchen Pflanzenarten die Inokulation mit AMF und weiteren nützlichen Mikroben den Ernteertrag fördern.

• Verwenden Sie molekulare Werkzeuge (qPCR, Metabarcoding) und Mikroskopie, um zu beurteilen, ob die angeimpften Mikroben Boden und / oder Pflanzenwurzeln besiedeln und sich auf dem Feld etablieren.

• Beitrag zur Datenanalyse und -berichterstattung.

• Ergebnisse in einflussreichen, von Experten begutachteten Fachzeitschriften veröffentlichen.

Anforderungen:
• Master-Abschluss in Mikrobiologie, Agronomie, mikrobielle Ökologie, Mikrobiomforschung oder Botanik mit ausgezeichneten Noten.

• Expertise in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Themen: Gewächshaus- oder Feldexperimente mit Pflanzen, mikrobielle Ökologie, Pilze, Bakterien, molekulare und mikrobiologische Methoden.

• Starke statistische Fähigkeiten wären von Vorteil

• Eine leistungsorientierte und aufgeschlossene Persönlichkeit mit guter Teamfähigkeit. Bereitschaft, auf dem Feld zu arbeiten (Erntetage sind lang und machen Spaß!)

• Schweizerdeutsch ist manchmal von Vorteil (z.B. um mit Landwirten zu interagieren), ist aber nicht erforderlich. Englisch ist unsere Arbeitssprache.

• Die Universität Zürich ist die größte Universität der Schweiz und verfügt über hervorragende Einrichtungen für Forschung und Lehre sowie über ein inspirierendes, aufgeschlossenes und soziales Umfeld.

Wir bieten:
Unsere Mitarbeiter profitieren von einer breiten Palette attraktiver Angebote. Weitere Informationen finden Sie unter https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

jobs.description:
Als grösste Universität der Schweiz bietet die Universität Zürich eine Vielzahl von attraktiven Positionen in verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Berufsfeldern. Mit rund 10'000 Mitarbeitenden und aktuell 12 Berufsprofilen für Lernende bietet die Universität ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld in der Spitzenforschung und Bildung. Setzen Sie Ihr Talent und Ihre Fähigkeiten bei uns ein. Erfahren Sie mehr über die UZH als Arbeitgeberin!

Aufgaben:
Gremienmanagement und Geschäftsvorbereitung
•	Koordination, Qualitätssicherung und fristgerechte Einreichung von Geschäften der Direktion Finanzen für Universitätsleitung, Universitätsrat und weitere zentrale Gremien
•	Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Gremienmanagements inklusive Einforderung, Prüfung und Qualitätssicherung von Entscheidungsgrundlagen

Direktionssupport und Administration
•	Organisation und Koordination von Jour fixes, Sitzungen, Workshops und Veranstaltungen der Direktion Finanzen
•	Sicherstellung eines effizienten Termin-, Dokumenten-, Freigabe- und Pendenzenmanagements sowie Unterstützung administrativer Abläufe

Qualitätssicherung und Weiterentwicklung
•	Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Qualitätssicherung von Berichten, Präsentationen und Entscheidungsgrundlagen
•	Mitarbeit bei finanz- und organisationsbezogenen Fragestellungen sowie bei der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen, Vorlagen und administrativen Abläufen
•	Unterstützung des Stabs bei Sonderaufträgen und bereichsübergreifenden Koordinationsaufgaben

Anforderungen:
•	Kaufmännische Ausbildung mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung in vergleichbaren Aufgabengebieten
•	Ausgeprägtes Organisationsgeschick sowie eine strukturierte, sorgfältige und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
•	Sehr gute redaktionelle Fähigkeiten und stilsicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Englisch von Vorteil
•	Fähigkeit, komplexe Zusammenhänge rasch zu erfassen und unterschiedliche Anspruchsgruppen professionell zu koordinieren
•	Hohe Dienstleistungsorientierung, Verlässlichkeit und Diskretion
•	Sehr gute Kenntnisse der gängigen Office-Anwendungen und digitalen Kollaborationstools

Worauf Sie sich freuen dürfen
•	Eine verantwortungsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit grosser organisatorischer Breite
•	Ein dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit vielfältigen Kontakten innerhalb zentraler Führungsgremien
•	Die Möglichkeit, zentrale Prozesse und Geschäfte der Universität aktiv mitzugestalten
•	Ein kollegiales und engagiertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
•	Moderne Arbeitsbedingungen und flexible Arbeitsformen
•	Einen attraktiven Arbeitsplatz im Zentrum von Zürich

Warum diese Stelle besonders spannend ist
Diese Stelle bietet die seltene Gelegenheit, zentrale Entscheidungs- und Steuerungsprozesse einer der grössten Universitäten Europas aus nächster Nähe mitzugestalten. In einem dynamischen Umfeld mit vielfältigen Anspruchsgruppen übernehmen Sie eine wichtige Koordinations- und Drehscheibenfunktion, schaffen Transparenz, sorgen für Verbindlichkeit und leisten damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Handlungsfähigkeit der Direktion Finanzen. Die Funktion verbindet organisatorisches Geschick mit einem breiten Einblick in die strategische Weiterentwicklung der Universität und bietet ein abwechslungsreiches Arbeitsfeld mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und grosser Wirkung.

Con circa 10.000 dipendenti e attualmente 12 profili professionali per gli studenti, l'università offre un ambiente di lavoro stimolante nella ricerca e nell'istruzione all'avanguardia. Compiti:
Gestione e preparazione aziendale
• Coordinamento, garanzia della qualità e tempestiva presentazione dei finanziamenti per la gestione universitaria, consiglio universitario e altri organi centrali
• Garantire una gestione regolare delle tavole, compresa la richiesta, la revisione e la garanzia di qualità della base per il processo decisionale

Direzione Sostegno e Amministrazione
• Organizzazione e coordinamento di Jour fix, incontri, workshop ed eventi della Direzione Finanza
• Garantire una gestione efficiente degli appuntamenti, dei documenti, dei comunicati e dei pendenti, nonché sostenere i processi amministrativi

Garanzia di qualità e ulteriore sviluppo
• Sostegno alla preparazione e all'assicurazione della qualità delle relazioni, delle presentazioni e delle basi decisionali
• Partecipazione a questioni finanziarie e organizzative nonché all'ulteriore sviluppo di processi, modelli e processi amministrativi
• Assistenza al personale per contratti specifici e compiti di coordinamento trasversale

Requisiti
• Formazione commerciale con diversi anni di esperienza professionale in settori comparabili di responsabilità
• Forte capacità organizzative e un metodo di lavoro strutturato, attento e indipendente
• Molto buone capacità editoriali e tedesco elegante in parola e scrittura, l'inglese è vantaggioso
• Capacità di cogliere rapidamente relazioni complesse e coordinare professionalmente diversi stakeholder
• Alto orientamento al servizio, affidabilità e discrezione
• Ottima conoscenza delle applicazioni di ufficio comuni e degli strumenti di collaborazione digitale

Che cosa si può guardare avanti
• Un'attività responsabile e varia con una grande ampiezza organizzativa
• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico con diversi contatti all'interno degli organi di gestione centrali
• L'opportunità di plasmare attivamente i processi centrali e gli affari dell'università
• Un team collaborativo e impegnato con brevi percorsi decisionali
• Condizioni di lavoro moderne e forme flessibili di lavoro
• Un posto di lavoro attraente nel centro di Zurigo

Perché questo lavoro è particolarmente emozionante
Questa posizione offre la rara opportunità di contribuire a plasmare i processi decisionali e di controllo centrali in una delle più grandi università d'Europa da vicino. In un ambiente dinamico con diversi gruppi di stakeholder, si assume un importante coordinamento e funzione hub, creare trasparenza, garantire l'impegno e quindi dare un contributo significativo alla capacità della Direzione delle Finanze di agire. La funzione combina l'abilità organizzativa con una vasta visione dello sviluppo strategico dell'università e offre un campo di lavoro vario con alta responsabilità personale e grande impatto.

Aufgaben:
In collaboration with a team from the NCCR Work Package “Events” and under the supervision of Professor Balthasar Bickel, the postdoc will lead and develop a series of studies using chiefly experimental methods to investigate language processing and planning and the wider cognitive background of this in a diverse set of languages, drawing chiefly on the NCCR's existing network of collaborations worldwide ( NCCR research facilities ). Experience with cross-cultural fieldwork is an additional strong asset.

The NCCR Evolving Language places great emphasis on teamwork and multidisciplinary perspectives. Strong communication and collaboration skills are essential. Excellent oral and written communication in English is required.
